# deepmodebot

> deepmodebot is an open-source MIT plugin combining a self-hosted GitHub review bot with coding-agent workflows. Owner-controlled bot roles use ACP agents through acpx and existing subscription logins. Outside-contributor reviews use a separate tool-free omp process. The skill set routes planning, implementation, review and delivery through one `/deep` command.

Key facts:

- Real run: the bots took PR #19 (https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/pull/19) through 5 cycles. Two failed panels caught real bugs; the third passed 2/3 and the bot squash-merged it.
- Self-hosted: `bot.py watch` polls the repos where your app is installed every 120 seconds. Installing the app on a repo is the opt-in.
- Subscriptions, not model API keys: supported agent CLIs use existing subscription logins. Prompts and source context can reach the configured model provider; self-hosted does not mean offline.
- Harness choice: owner-controlled bot roles are configurable ACP agents. Outside-contributor review currently requires omp. Portable skill instructions do not establish equal results across every harness.
- Merge gate in code: only your own PRs merge, at the head the panel voted on, with required checks green, no conflict, and `autonomousMerge` allowed. Outside PRs receive comments based on their diff and bounded, omission-labelled Git source context, never PR code execution.
- Conflicts are resolved by merging the base into the head. Never rebase or force-push.
- Install the bots: `git clone https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot`, `cd deepmodebot/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot`, `py -3 assets/github-app/install.py`.
- Install the skills: `omp plugin marketplace add TimothyVang/deepmodebot` then `omp plugin install deepmodebot@deepmodebot`; in Claude Code, `/plugin marketplace add TimothyVang/deepmodebot` and `/plugin install deepmodebot@deepmodebot`.
- Local delivery: ordinary small and medium local tasks leave proven, uncommitted changes in the starting tree. Publication adds review and verifier-panel gates.
- Measured delivery: on one development-known feature fixture, the revised command finished 5/5 runs and passed all 19 CLI checks in each. Plain-agent runs also finished 5/5 and passed all 19 checks, with lower median reported usage ($0.9754 versus $1.6271). These are harness estimates, not subscription invoices. Small samples and same-provider judges do not establish general superiority.
- Evidence limits: a demonstrated PR merge is not a comparative accuracy benchmark. Workflow mappings are not execution results. Read the evaluation methods and retained results before making equivalence claims.
- White-label: one `brand.json` and `py -3 scripts/whitelabel.py --brand <file> --out <dir>` rebrand everything: the product name and logo, colors, commands, skills, the bot and its GitHub App, the docs site, the README, images, and the SEO and llms files. LICENSE and NOTICE stay, with your copyright line added. `install.py --brand <name>` is a shortcut that renames only the bots.

## Docs

- [Site](https://timothyvang.github.io/deepmodebot/): overview, the real PR #19 run, diagrams, the software factory, install, safety, FAQ
- [README](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/README.md): what the plugin ships, install, the bots, the software factory, FAQ
- [Flow map](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/flows.md): the main line from idea to merged code, on-ramps, and what to do between phases
- [github-app technique](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/github-app.md): setup with install.py, running the poller, bot.json, opt-out, safety
- [pr-conversation technique](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/pr-conversation.md): the author, reviewer and verifier turns over ACP, the panel, and every merge gate
- [issue-conversation technique](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/issue-conversation.md): plan, critique and answer in the issue thread, then build on the owner's issues
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/SKILL.md): the router, principles, playbooks and techniques of the deepmodebot skill
- [Tool routing](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/tool-routing.md): select supporting skills and available capabilities without widening permissions
- [LangChain ecosystem](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/agent-harnesses/references/langchain-ecosystem.md): LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith decisions
- [Containers](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/cloud-devsecops/references/containers.md): Docker, Compose, image builds, runtimes and bounded local workflows
- [Kubernetes](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/cloud-devsecops/references/kubernetes.md): workload operations, ecosystem selection and scoped operational loops
- [AI SDK selection](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/agent-harnesses/references/ai-sdk-selection.md): use-case recommendations, execution boundaries and source-linked tradeoffs
- [Goal review](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/goal-review.md): quantitative milestones, context questions and three independent ACP reviewers
- [Agent collaboration](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/agent-collaboration.md): native sibling messaging, ACP session identity and blind review boundaries
- [Visual E2E](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/visual-e2e.md): real recording, replay, per-step evidence and three independent native image reviewers
- [Open design evidence](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/references/techniques/open-design-evidence.md): portable editable workflow exports, embedded raster screenshots and explicit design-tool import limits
- [Invoice pilot evidence](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/docs/evidence/ecosystem-pilot-2026-11-13/README.md): six-step synthetic browser/HTTP/SQLite journey, replay, SQL proof, visual majority and dissent; not a general benchmark
- [Rebrand guide](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/docs/rebrand.md): ship deepmodebot as your own product with one brand file and one build command
- [Evaluations](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/tree/main/evals): delivery comparisons, review-quality measurements, workflow inventories and their explicit limits
- [Local delivery results](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/evals/results/local-delivery-2026-11-12.md): measured completion and artifact correctness, the cheaper plain-agent baseline, corrections and limits

Tool routing and the collaboration, visual and design references supply supporting capabilities. The user's ordinary research, debugging, review or implementation intent still selects the primary playbook.

## Code

- [install.py](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/assets/github-app/install.py): one-command setup: tools, agents, ACP round trip, the GitHub App, bot.json, autostart
- [bot.py](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/assets/github-app/bot.py): the poller and coordinator that runs the conversations and enforces the gates
- [ghapp.py](https://github.com/TimothyVang/deepmodebot/blob/main/plugins/deepmodebot/skills/deepmodebot/assets/github-app/ghapp.py): creates your private GitHub App with the manifest flow and mints installation tokens
